<thought>Applying retrosynthetic template 41227 to the target sulfonamide SMILES “NS(=O)(=O)c1ccccc1” yields one set of precursors: the amine “Nc1ccc2c(c1)C(=O)c1ccccc1C2=O” and the sulfonyl chloride “O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1”. This matches the template’s retro‑transformation, so the required list of precursor combinations is a single inner list containing these two SMILES.</thought>
<final_answer>[["Nc1ccc2c(c1)C(=O)c1ccccc1C2=O", "O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1"]]</final_answer>
